opening.argument: The speaker demonstrates a paid route into the mining pool: viewers are shown how to set up an account and buy a package, with a $99 membership fee and $500 going into the investment. He presents the arrangement as a way to accumulate Bitcoin, explaining, “I'm looking to mine at 100% for at least 9 to 12 months so I can acquire as much bitcoin as I can through the mining pool share.” The solicitation extends beyond individual purchases. He claims daily team commissions and describes the person whose package he is setting up as part of his team. Together, the payment request, claimed mining returns, and recruitment-based income establish a concrete offer to join and build the business, not merely a report about the service.
